text:
**One backend seam, two backends.** Rust owns a `WalletBackend` trait. NWC (NIP-47) is the Lightning/BOLT-11 backend; Cashu (NIP-60) is the ecash backend. A composition layer picks which backend handles a given action. Zaps (NIP-57) don't know or care which — they just emit a "pay this" intent through a `PaymentPort` and the selected backend fulfills it. [...] Assistant: Full context now clear: epic **#2864** exists, **Phase 0 is done** (nmp-nip60 reactivated, PR #2866 merged), and **Phase 1 = the `nmp-wallet` composition crate** — whose "durable operation journal" checkbox is exactly what this whole conversation refined. So the right home for the capture is the canonical architecture doc (which the epic points at), added via a PR, plus a pointer on #2864. [...] > **Task: begin Phase 1 of the NIP-60/61 wallet epic (#2864) — the `nmp-wallet` composition crate, journal/reducer spine first.** [...] > 1. Scaffold the new Layer-4 crate `crates/nmp-wallet` (parked/excluded from the default workspace, same posture `nmp-nip60` had, since its actions aren't shippable yet — confirm the parking approach against the epic).
> 2. Define the `WalletBackend` seam per the design: actor-owned, command-shaped, returns `Vec<ActorCommand>`, never blocks across FFI, capability-flag model (absent capability ≠ runtime failure). [...] > **Hard invariants (from the design doc + #2864 — treat as acceptance criteria):** reducer is **confluent** (a NIP-09 delete arriving before its `kind:7375` tombstones, not no-ops); the ring is **never a rebuild authority** (restart rebuilds from Nostr + saga reconcile via a `StateRebuilt` genesis fact); durable causal tier is **`kind:7376` + token `del` fields**, not a local store; **type-level privacy** (no proofs/secrets/keys in any `WalletFact`, log, or projection); `nmp-core` learns **no** Cashu/nutzap/NWC/mint nouns; proof-set derivation is actor-owned, **not** on Trellis (Trellis is acquisition-layer only). Prove confluence and restart-reconcile with tests (out-of-order delete, mint-probe-found-spent, crash-after-`MintSettled`). [...] `ACTION_LEGACY_NWC_CONNECT`/`ACTION_LEGACY_NWC_DISCONNECT` deleted; there's now exactly one `ACTION_NWC_CONNECT`/`ACTION_NWC_DISCONNECT` pair using nmp-nip47's real current names (`nmp.wallet.connect`/`nmp.wallet.disconnect`). I did NOT rename these to the aspirational `nmp.wallet.nwc.connect`/`nwc.disconnect` from the design doc's Product Surface list, because nothing implements that name today — nmp-nip47 is the only real backend, under the current names. Renaming requires moving nmp-nip47's ActionModule + wire-schema registration, which is epic #2864 Phase 2 (NWC consolidation) and crosses into nmp-nip47's lane. `pay_invoice` was untouched — it's already the single canonical name per the design doc, not an alias pair. Added a test (`no_action_namespace_is_duplicated_as_a_compatibility_alias`) asserting no two wallet action constants share a string value. [...] - Verdict on your Q1: they are two *genuinely distinct types* (nip47's wraps a `WalletRuntimeHandle` → emits `WalletPayInvoiceCommand`; wallet's wraps an abstract `WalletPaymentCommandFactory` → delegates). So not literal code duplication, and no runtime double-wire *today* because nmp-wallet is unconsumed. BUT: (a) identical name + identical trait is a real confusion hazard, and (b) the lib.rs/ownership prose is a **silent port-ownership reassignment in metadata** — exactly the framing #2869 corrected in the design doc, which the crate's own descriptor then re-asserted. The design's stated selection mechanism is "supply the selected backend's `Arc<dyn PaymentPort>`" via `nmp_nip57::Config::with_payment_port` (`design:82-83,115`) — that needs nmp-nip47's port passed through; it does NOT require nmp-wallet to define a second `PaymentPort` impl at all.
- Fix: either delete nmp-wallet's `WalletPaymentPort`/`WalletPaymentCommandFactory` (selection = pass nip47's `Arc<dyn PaymentPort>` through), or if a routing indirection is truly wanted, rename it (e.g. `WalletBackendPaymentRouter`) so it can't be mistaken for the adapter, and reword `lib.rs:6` + `ownership.rs:4,107` to "selects the PaymentPort backend," never "owns the PaymentPort adapter." [...] - **capability.rs** flags exactly match the epic's 8-flag list (pay_bolt11, create_cashu_wallet, publish_nutzap_info, send_nutzap, redeem_nutzap, deposit_cashu, melt_cashu, observe_nutzap_receipts). ✔ [...] - **Relay authority reconciles**: design + nip60 reality both make kind:10019/NIP-65 authoritative and `legacy_relay_hint` decode-only; #2874 stopped `build_wallet_event` emitting relay tags and made `publish_nutzap_info` take an explicit `relays` param. ✔ [...] Assistant: The old product used NDKSwift/CashuSwift and NIP-38000 mint discovery — that's **NIP-87 (Ecash Mint Discoverability)**: kind:38172 mint announcements, kind:38000 recommendations. Good grounding. [...] - `start_intent()`: `WalletIntent::PayBolt11{bolt11, amount_msats}` → `ActorCommand::Protocol(Box::new(WalletPayInvoiceCommand{bolt11, amount_msats, correlation_id, runtime}))` — the same command `nmp.wallet.pay_invoice`'s `ActionModule` already emits. Every Cashu/nutzap/select-backend variant is a documented `Vec::new()` no-op (D6, never a panic). Doc comment flags that this method does NOT itself validate/dedupe bolt11 (mirrors `ActionModule::execute` vs `start`) — whichever future nmp-wallet dispatch path calls this seam needs to apply the same non-empty/no-retap gate `WalletPayInvoiceModule::start` applies today.
- `snapshot()`: derives `WalletReadiness` from nmp-nip47's shared `WalletStatus` slot. V-79 heartbeat `connection_state` is checked before the raw status token and wins on `Reconnecting`/`TransportLost` — including while status is still `"connecting"` (heartbeat ticks before the first kind:23195 response ever lands, so this isn't only a `"ready"`-token case). `balances` stays empty: `WalletBalanceRow` is a per-mint Cashu row, a single-purse Lightning balance has no mint analog.
- `on_wallet_event`/`on_mint_result`: documented no-ops, not silently skipped. [...] Constructing a live `NwcWalletBackend` needs both `WalletRuntimeHandle` AND a `WalletStatusSlot` clone bound to the *same* runtime instance. `nmp_nip47::register()`'s returned `Handles` only exposes `Handles::wallet` (the runtime handle) today, not the status slot — there's no way from outside nmp-nip47 to get the slot for an already-registered runtime. Wiring this end-to-end needs either a small `nmp-nip47` change (e.g. add `Handles::status: WalletStatusSlot`) or composition-root work — out of my `crates/nmp-wallet/` lane, so I stopped short of touching nmp-nip47 and left it as a constructor param + doc note instead.

Also structurally: `on_wallet_event(&KernelEvent) -> Vec<ActorCommand>` cannot drive real kind:23195 reconciliation — nmp-nip47's actual decode path (`WalletInterceptor`/`dispatch_nwc_relay_text`) needs raw relay frame text + the connection's NIP-04/44 secret and returns `Vec<OutboundMessage>`, a different shape on both ends. That reconciliation keeps running through nmp-nip47's existing interceptor; bridging it into this generic seam is real actor-wiring work, so I left it untouched rather than guessing — flagging for W7.
